secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the in-app AI troubleshooting assistant (OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible provider). Optional: without it the rest of the app works and the assistant panel reports 'Not configured'. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

secrets.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL for the assistant, e.g. a Groq/OpenRouter/Ollama endpoint. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1

secrets.name: OPENAI_MODEL
secrets.description: Optional chat model name for the assistant. Defaults to gpt-4o-mini
